what: On first open, a cover fills the screen and a centered logo rises from 10px below and transparent over 1s ease to settle. Once the page has fully loaded and at least 1.8s has passed since opening (2.5s at the latest), the cover fades out over .8s ease and is removed .8s later — a solid-color logo loader for low-motion shop and wedding sites.

options.ease: Curve for the curtain reveal — if in the form ”0.37,0,0.63,1” use cubic-bezier, otherwise a CSS curve name. Default ease · Brand 0.37,0,0.63,1 (jQuery swing)
options.after: Waits this many more seconds after load before lifting — regardless of when it opened (instead of min). If given, max defaults to after + 6s · Brand 2 (sub pages 0)
options.min: Minimum time (seconds) shown after opening, default 1.8 · at 0 it lifts right at load
options.max: Time (s) after which it clears even if load never arrives, default 2.5
options.fade: Curtain fade duration (seconds), default .8 — 0 removes it instantly
options.fx:done: Event emitted from the element when the curtain starts lifting — put the Hero motion here
options.look: “blink” — the logo doesn’t rise but turns on in place after .1s over .7s power2.out, stays for .25s, turns off over .7s power2.inOut, and then the curtain lifts with power2.inOut (Name). The curtain-lift time is set by min·max (.15s after the fade-out ends = 1.9)
options.delay: Delay (sec) before a blink-type logo turns on, default .1
options.hold: Time (seconds) the logo stays lit in blink Type, default .25
options.out: Duration (s) for the blink-type logo to turn off, default .7

from.where: shared.js #sh-loader — white logo centered on a pink curtain

index.js .intro (first-visit loader — original #js-intro-01 logo opacity 0→1 .7s power2.out delay .1 → 1→0 .7s power2.inOut delay .25 → #js-intro-02 curtain opacity 0 .9s power2.inOut delay .15. While the curtain lifts, the logo and nav enter from 40px to the side and the tagline and sun enter from 12px blur — those are in the site index.js, outside the part)
